scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:vertical
scripts.render:audio: npm run audio && ffmpeg -y -i out/orvia-16x9.mp4 -i out/audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=7 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -shortest out/orvia-16x9-audio.mp4 && ffmpeg -y -i out/orvia-9x16.mp4 -i out/audio.wav -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -af loudnorm=I=-16:TP=-1.5:LRA=7 -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 48000 -shortest out/orvia-9x16-audio.mp4
scripts.render:narrated: npm run audio -- --vo && remotion render src/index.ts Orvia16x9VO out/narrated-16x9.mp4 && remotion render src/index.ts Orvia9x16VO out/narrated-9x16.mp4 && node audio/make-voiceover.mjs
